lesson.concept: sin 2x is not 2 sin x. It is 2 sin x cos x. cos 2x is not 2 cos x. It is cos²x - sin²x, or 2cos²x - 1, or 1 - 2sin²x.
lesson.why: This is one of the most frequent errors DBE reported for this section.

work: The double angle formula: sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x.
Do not confuse this with 2 sin x.
The '2' means the angle is doubled, not the ratio.

learner_message: sin 2x is not 2 sin x. It is 2 sin x cos x. cos 2x is never 2 cos x.
